summary: Software engineer who builds backend services and developer tools. Comfortable in TypeScript, Python and Go, with experience taking features from prototype to production.

bullets.text: Modules: Distributed Systems, Databases, Machine Learning.
Final-year project: a query planner for a toy SQL engine, 1st class.
Built a Go service that ingests 2M events/day from Kafka into PostgreSQL with exactly-once semantics.
Cut p95 API latency from 800ms to 120ms by adding Redis caching and fixing N+1 queries.
Wrote Playwright end-to-end tests covering the checkout flow, catching 3 regressions before release.
Led the migration of CI from Jenkins to GitHub Actions, halving build time.
Ran weekly labs for 40 students on data structures & algorithms in C++.
Marked coursework and gave written feedback within 48 hours.
Built a Next.js + TypeScript app that turns GPX files into day-by-day hiking plans with 15 API endpoints.
Deployed on a $5/month VPS with Docker Compose; ~90% of requests served from cache.
